settings.question: Do I pay anything right now?
settings.answer: Nope. You pay the rider in cash when your order arrives, anywhere in Pakistan. Delivery is free.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are usually delivered in 3 to 5 working days. We confirm every order on WhatsApp before dispatch.

settings.question: How soon will I see results?
settings.answer: Results vary from person to person. With regular daily use, morning and night, skin can look fresher and more even over time.

settings.question: Can I use it every day?
settings.answer: Yes. Glossira is lightweight, non-greasy and gentle enough to use every morning and night. We recommend a patch test before first use.

settings.question: What if something is not right?
settings.answer: We offer an easy 7-day return policy so you can shop with confidence. See our Refund Policy for details.
